home2.s1_lead: Drop a file, paste a screenshot or fetch a picture from a link. It is online before you reach for the mouse.
home2.s1_d1: Drag a file in, paste with Ctrl+V or pick it from a folder. Images, videos and PDFs.
home2.s1_d2: The location and camera details are removed, and the picture is not re-compressed.
home2.s1_d3: A short link and a direct link to the file, ready to copy.
home2.s1_d4: Chats, forums, docs, a README. The link keeps working.
home2.s2_lead: A photo from a phone carries more than the picture. PixelHop removes it on upload, before anyone can see it.
home2.s2_d1: The file arrives with a place, a camera and a time inside it.
home2.s2_d2: Location, camera and time are removed, one field at a time.
home2.s2_d3: The pixels are not touched, so nothing is lost.
home2.s2_d4: What is shared is the picture and nothing about where you were.
home2.s3_h: Not just an uploader. A whole studio.
home2.s3_lead: Edit a picture before you share it. The studio works in your browser, so a file is not uploaded until you choose to.
home2.c_crop_d: Cut to a ratio or draw your own frame.
home2.c_convert_d: PNG, JPEG, WebP and AVIF, either way.
home2.c_redact_d: Hide a face or a number before you share.
home2.c_ocr_d: Copy the words out of a screenshot.
home2.c_rembg_d: Lift the subject off its background.
home2.c_palette_d: Pick the colours of a picture.
home2.s4_lead: Put pictures in an album and share the album. Copy any file as a link, a direct link, Markdown, HTML or BBCode.
home2.s4_d1: A holiday, a build log, a set of screenshots.
home2.s4_d2: One page with all of them, in the order you chose.
home2.s4_d3: The right snippet for a forum, a chat, a web page or a README.
home2.s4_d4: Paste once. Everyone sees the same thing.
home2.s5_lead: Choose how long a file should live. When the time is up, it is deleted from the server.
home2.s5_d1: Ten minutes, an hour, a day, a month. Or never.
home2.s5_d2: The link works while the time runs.
home2.s5_d3: The file is deleted. Nothing is kept behind it.
